Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite proliferate; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Roalesk, Apex Hybrid (battlefield); Blade of Shared Souls (battlefield); Herd Baloth (battlefield); Pentad Prism (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
  Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it
  Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Steps: Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
  Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
  Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
  The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth and two charge counters on Pentad Prism.
  Herd Baloth triggers twice, creating two 4/4 Beast creature tokens.
  Activate Pentad Prism twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
  Repeat.

## Combo 972-1018-2792
Cards: Saheeli's Artistry + Skullwinder + Great Whale
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U}{U}
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite recursion of instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard; Infinite copies of all creatures; Infinite copies of all artifacts; Infinite untap of lands you control; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite magecraft triggers; Target opponent returns all cards in their graveyard to their hand
Start: Saheeli's Artistry (hand); Skullwinder (battlefield); Great Whale (hand)
Prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
Steps: Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
  Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
  When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
  Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
  When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
  Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
  Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Skullwinder and the Great Whale token.
  When the Skullwinder and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
  Resolve the Skullwinder token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
  Repeat from step 6.
Notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Skullwinder instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Progenitor Mimic (battlefield); Skullwinder (battlefield); Walk the Aeons (hand)
Prerequisites: Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
  Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Skullwinder.
Steps: Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
  At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
  When the token Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 24 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite untap of lands you control; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite blinking; Infinite landfall triggers; Target opponent returns all cards in their graveyard to their hand
Start: Displace (hand); Skullwinder (battlefield); Great Whale (hand)
Prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
Steps: Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.

  Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 93 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {15}{G}{U}
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite copies of all permanents; Infinite mana permanents you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand
Start: Doppelgang (hand); Salvager of Secrets (battlefield)
Prerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
Steps: Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Salvager of Secrets and of the four mana-producing permanents.
  When the Salvager of Secrets tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
  Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
  Repeat.
  Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

## Combo 1309-5478-5531-5694-8110
Cards: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods + Famished Worldsire + Eldrazi Confluence + Salvager of Secrets + Spelunking
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite self-mill; Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield; Infinite blinking; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count; Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0
Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Salvager of Secrets (battlefield); Spelunking (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
  As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
  When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
  Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
  An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 35 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite green mana; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Start: Experiment Kraj (battlefield); Devoted Druid (battlefield); Primal Vigor (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
  Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
  Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
  Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
  Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
  Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
  Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
  Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
  You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite colored mana; Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

  There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
Steps: Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

  Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
  When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
  Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
  Repeat.
